title: Network Virtualization Primer
scenario: Welcome to Network Virtualization Primer. Before proceeding, you must master these essential networking terms. Virtual Extensible LAN (VXLAN): Layer 2 overlay over Layer 3 network. Uses UDP 4789. Extends VLANs across routed networks (data centers, cloud). Supports 16 million VNIs vs 4094 VLAN limit. Used in SDN/overlay networks.
question: What does VXLAN stand for?
explanation: VXLAN stands for Virtual Extensible LAN.
